newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai shrimp exports drop 14 percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Thai shrimp exports drop 14 percent in 1996.

text.p: Thai shrimp exports dropped 14 percent to 43.4 billion baht ($1.67 billion) in 1996 from 50.3 billion a year earlier, a commerce ministry official said on Monday.
He said Thailand, the world largest shrimp exporter, shipped out 161,486 tonnes in 1996, eight percent lower than 1995.
The United States and Japan continued to be major markets for Thai shrimps. The US imported 72,611 tonnes and Japan bought 64,144 tonnes in 1996.

India, Indonesia and Ecuador emerged as Thailand's major competitors. India dominated the Japanese market in 1996 while Equador trailed Thailand as the second largest exporter to the US, according to the official.
